_note: RalfyIndex submission. The API key is NOT here - it lives in the macOS keychain (service 'ralfyindex-api'), because this repo is public and is itself the web root. Endpoint and payload confirmed against the dashboard example: POST /project with apikey, projectName and a urls array.
_submit_note: One credit per URL. Draw pages are excluded by default: four a day is ~1,460 credits a year, and a dated archive page gains nothing from being indexed in five minutes rather than by the next sitemap crawl. Set draw to true to submit them anyway.
